verdict.rationale: AWS IAM provides granular JSON policies, roles with temporary least-privilege credentials, permission boundaries, and OIDC federation for external agents/apps (e.g., GitHub Actions), all directly enabling scoped, temporary API credentials rather than long-lived broad keys. AgentCore explicitly builds on this to handle authentication/access control for AI agents calling APIs, MCP servers, and Lambda functions with per-call authorization. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence confirming ease of scoping credentials specifically for agent workflows in practice.
